correctness.rationale: The specified coin chi=(sqrt(ell),-2,sqrt(ell))/sqrt(2(ell+2)) is orthogonal to the flat band, so the existing dispersive ballistic law with group speed u=√(ell/(ell+2)) yields even velocity density rho(v)=√(1-u²)/(π(1-v²)√(u²-v²)) for |v|<u. The independent geometric age A_q has qA_q⇒Exp(1); joint ballistic/age convergence and |X_a|<=a with geometric tails give qX_stat⇒EV and convergence of all positive moments. Conditioning gives CF (1+ξ²√((1-u²)/(1+u²ξ²)))/(1+ξ²), checked via partial fractions; density g(y)=∫_0^u rho(v)e^{-|y|/v}dv/v. The rho(0) expansion gives log coefficient (1/π)√(2/ell), and the sqrt edge singularity plus Laplace method gives g(y)~sqrt((ell+2)/(4πu|y|)) exp(-|y|/u). At t=floor(z/q) the last age⇒min(E,z), and its mass e^-z at z produces inverse-sqrt ballistic front with exact stated prefactor. Sequential ell→0 after weak resetting gives K0/π for Y/u and ell→∞ gives symmetric Laplace. Fresh numerical coin Fourier-eigenspace checks verified dark overlap zero, equal dispersive weights and transform normalization for ell=.4,2,8. These are corroborations, not a proof of the originating spectral theorem.
residual_risks: Fixed ell>0 before q↓0; endpoints iterated, not simultaneous.
